feature: Pinned lazer playfield framing for the session viewport transform (supersedes complete-map visual bounds fitting)

upstream_sources.role: playfield_size_adjust = 0.8 relative size, Anchor/Origin Centre, 4:3 FillMode.Fit child, ScalingContainer content scale = ChildSize.X / 512; source comment derives the osu-stable magic ratio 1.6 at the 1024x768 game size. AlignWithStoryboard downward shift is the positional adjustment this framing does not implement.

BASE_SIZE = (512, 384); UpdateSubTreeMasking() => false ("everything is always on screen") — upstream does not clip content to the logical playfield, correcting the earlier local claim that lazer crops oversized content.
Base container contributes RelativeSizeAxes = Both only; no additional scaling in the composition.

composition.formula: scale_css = 0.8 * min(viewport_width / 512, viewport_height / 384), logical playfield centred in the viewport
composition.derivation: OsuPlayfieldAdjustmentContainer centres itself (Anchor/Origin Centre), takes Size = 0.8 of the parent, its FillMode.Fit child with FillAspectRatio 4/3 letterboxes to width 0.8 * min(W, 4H/3), and ScalingContainer scales content by that width / 512. Over parent (W, H) this composes to 0.8 * min(W/512, H/384) applied uniformly to positions, sizes and distances, centred.
composition.cross_check: At the upstream 1024x768 game size the formula yields exactly 1.6, the osu-stable magic ratio quoted in the pinned source comment.

adjusted_framing_is_map_independent_by_construction: repeated queries identical; framing scale equals PLAYFIELD_SIZE_ADJUST * sessionless fit scale
adjusted_framing_round_trips_and_ignores_dpr: forward/inverse round trips incl. off-rectangle points, DPR-independent CSS coefficients, f32 NDC containment of the playfield rectangle
engine/tests/scene_test.odin: session_transform_uses_map_independent_framing_and_validates: identical transform across extreme/plain maps before and after scene attachment publication, attachment-free success, allocation-free query, DPR independence, invalid viewport preserves prior bytes, wrong output span and stale handle rejection, preserved transactional geometry validation (non-finite prepared geometry rejects scene-resource creation)

scene_draw_frame_transform_uses_pinned_framing: frame header equals the adjusted transform across draw times; an object at (560, 420) maps beyond the framed playfield edges while remaining on-canvas (unclipped)
platform/browser-js/tests/engine.test.mj: session viewport transform uses pinned map-independent framing: 1920x1080 -> scale 2.25, playfield 1152x864 centred; extreme/plain maps identical; scale = 0.8 * sessionless fit; off-rectangle object addressable outside the framed playfield; attachment publication and DPR change nothing; invalid viewport preserves bytes; stale handle rejects
